about: Net calorific values (NCV) and densities for KPI-5's energy adapters: a fuel row's quantity in a mass or volume unit becomes energy (GJ) as quantity × density × NCV. Used only when the row's factor snapshot carries no NCV of its own. A fuel is found by the first entry (more specific names first) whose `match` words appear in the row's activity name (case-insensitive). A row whose fuel or unit isn't here is listed as skipped, never guessed. `verified` is per fuel and is about its density: true = equal to the row named in `density_row` of the DESNZ table below; false = no density is used for it (mass only), see `note`.
ncv_source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol. 2 Energy, Chapter 1, Table 1.2 (default net calorific values, TJ/Gg = GJ/tonne).
density_source: UK Government GHG Conversion Factors for Company Reporting 2025 (DESNZ, version 1, published 10 June 2025), full set, sheet 'Fuel properties', column 'Density, kg/m3' (stored here as kg/litre = kg/m3 ÷ 1000, natural gas as kg/m3).
